items.title: The 8:30: Trump-Xi summit takeaways, an interview with Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella
items.summary: The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley break down the biggest market and business stories driving the day's conversation. From the latest updates from President Trump's summit with Xi Jinping to Costco's (COST) latest earnings, The 8:30 panel delivers the essential headlines and market context you need to start your day informed. Deirdre Bosa also comes on to discuss her recent interview with Microsoft (MSFT) CEO Satya Nadella.

items.title: What Happens To ExxonMobil Stock If Refining Profits Fade?
items.summary: The worry for ExxonMobil (XOM) holders is that its refineries stop earning high margins. Management said in late July that the Strait closure keeps about 3 million barrels a day of refining capacity off the market. The second quarter alone supplied $14.5 billion of the $32.8 billion ExxonMobil earned over the last twelve months. How much of that profit rests on refining, and what would you lose if its margins fell back.

items.title: Caterpillar or Exxon: Which Dividend Has More Room to Grow?
items.summary: Caterpillar just hit $20 billion in quarterly sales for the first time ever, while Exxon pumped out $23.6 billion in operating cash flow. Both companies raised their dividends, but their very different balance sheets tell a story about which payout has genuine room to run.
